list.text: \f[faceArcher]Archer: \c[4]The Legendary Pokémon Lugia is near... I can feel his power.
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]These rocks are blocking my path...
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]Voltobs, use Explosion!
\f[kimono]\r\PN, please don't allow him to do it!
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]Giovanni told me this was my last chance after the disaster at the Radio Tower...
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]I'll not give up this time, never!
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]I made this perfect plan...\nWe stole the Tidal Bell from the Kimono Girl, but just it is not enough to get Lugia attention...
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]The Silver Wing energy has to be near for it to work.
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]So it was part of our plan to lure you here, as you have the Silver Wing with you!
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]How do you feel knowing that you're helping us?\nHahahaha!
Archer used Tidal Bell.
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]Wow! Lugia is furious!
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]Oh no! I was so obsessed in luring you here that I forgot to heal my Pokémon!
\f[faceArcher]\c[4]I need to run away and call some backup before this Pokémon attacks me!
Furious Lugia attacks \PN!

list.ruby:
setBattleRule("cannotRun")
setBattleRule("canLose")
setBattleRule("disablePokeBalls")
pkmn = Pokemon.new(:LUGIA, 70)
pkmn.learn_move(:HYDROPUMP)
pkmn.learn_move(:EXTRASENSORY)
pkmn.learn_move(:AEROBLAST)
pkmn.learn_move(:RECOVER)
WildBattle.start(pkmn)

list.text: \f[face_Lugia]\bYou are a great trainer.
\f[face_Lugia]\bI came out of the depths of the waters only because these humans were planning a lot of evil and needed to be taught a lesson.
\f[face_Lugia]\bSorry I mistook you for one of them.
\f[face_Lugia]\bNow I know you are not a bad Trainer.
\f[face_Lugia]\bFarewell!
Um voltorb exausto...

Um voltorb exausto...

lines: Notice that invisible character needs to be used here,
otherwise it has a small glitch where the user goes
behind the stair for a frame.
Check the second page of the event as well, as it is important!

list.text: \f[kimono]Kuni: \r\PN, you proved once again that you're a brave Trainer.
\f[kimono]\rYou should be proud of yourself.
\f[kimono]\rPlease take this as a token of our apreciation.

then.text: \f[kimono]\rGrassium Z converts Z-Power into crystals that upgrade Grass-type moves to Grass-type Z-Moves.
\f[kimono]\rWaterium Z converts Z-Power into crystals that upgrade Water-type moves to Water-type Z-Moves.
\f[kimono]\rFirium Z converts Z-Power into crystals that upgrade Fire-type moves to Fire-type Z-Moves.

list.text: \f[kimono]\rThe Rockets ran away once my sisters arrived.\nI hope this is the last time they cause problems.
\f[kimono]\rWe should keep our eyes open...\nThey are really pushy...

else.text: \f[kimono]\rAnyway, you seem ready to take on the Pokémon League now!
\f[kimono]\rTo get there follow Route 27 to reach Route 26. Once you get there, go straight north!

list.text: \f[kimono]\rWe're going back to Ecruteak, hope to see you again there!
